name: cobuddy-admin
description: CoBuddy frontend and backend command launcher

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix cobuddy-frontend ci && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend ci
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix cobuddy-frontend run lint && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix cobuddy-frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run typecheck
scripts.format: npm --prefix cobuddy-frontend run format && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix cobuddy-frontend run format:check && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run format:check
scripts.verify:backend: npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run db:validate && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run typecheck && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run format:check && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run lint && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run test:unit && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run build
scripts.verify: npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:backend
scripts.check:production-config: npm --prefix cobuddy-backend run check:production-config && npm --prefix cobuddy-frontend run check:production-config
scripts.audit:production: npm --prefix cobuddy-frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix cobuddy-backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate
scripts.build:production: npm run check:production-config && npm run audit:production && npm run build
